condition: The head's `preflight_audit` value does not match the file-name pattern of a written preflight record (`<minute>-preflight[-n].toml`, not a failed attempt's name); nothing is looked up (audit_gaps.py:221).

preconditions: an answering run exists
its config.json reads
condition: The answering run's config.json carries `unfrozen_ack` true: a mark that is there and records how the run was started (in full, acknowledged over a protocol not frozen); no value names that recorded state.

preconditions: the script reads and parses (one that does not is skipped)
alternative: form (the constant's expression is of a kind the static evaluator does not take); or fits no: a limit of the check's evaluator, the script itself reads and parses
condition: A module-level `PROMPT`/`PROMPT_<VARIANT>` assignment in an area script does not evaluate to a string under the check's static evaluator (`_value_of`: a call other than `sep.join`, a format spec, a tuple, list or dict).

preconditions: `preflight_audit` names a record file that exists, reads and is of mode preflight
bundled: a scope file is missing: declared by a protocol's promise, imported by a script, or listed (FileNotFoundError, scope_sha.py:505)
no scope file at all under the area's globs and none declared (ValueError, scope_sha.py:507)
a protocol's promise block is malformed, so its declared scope cannot be read (ValueError)
a script or helper does not read or parse while imports are followed (SourceError, a ValueError)
condition: `area_stamp(area)` raises FileNotFoundError or ValueError (audit_gaps.py:255-259); the telling code puts the exception's text into one sentence and does not tell apart a missing scope file, an empty scope, an unreadable promise block and an unreadable source file.

preconditions: the file state checked is not the adoption's own proposal
condition: The file an adoption keeps beside the protocol while its check runs (`.<protocol>.before-adoption`) exists as a file: a file that is there and records that an adoption did not finish; no value names that state (report_check.py:653).

alternative: binding: the code also follows the link to its end and fires only when the end is no place a report is held (or the chain runs in a circle); a link ending at a held place passes
condition: The report's path is a symbolic link in the checked file state (index or tree) whose chain does not end at a place where a report is held (`refused_link`, report_hold.py:101-105).

preconditions: an answering run exists
a covering analysis record exists and reads
alternative: only the two roles decision and confirmation, the protocol's claim as part of what the confirmation is matched on and no object of its own
condition: A BLOCKER of a covering analysis record is decided `false-positive`, is not carried and was never not upheld, and no decision review upholds it: no review of that record (same record name, scope sha, shown sha) under the claim the protocol makes now (claim digest) and of the decision as it stands (decision digest) with a non-`--again` draw and every verdict `upheld` (reviews.py:349-352).

preconditions: the audit was called in mode preflight
the protocol's head reads
condition: The head's repeat cost puts the protocol on a lane that owes no preflight audit, and the area holds no completed run: a field's value and the absence of any completed run, two states read now and combined, no time or order read and nothing owed missing.

preconditions: an answering run exists
a covering analysis record exists and reads

condition: A finding of a covering analysis record decided `limitation` has the effect `stands`, and no decision review upholds it as decided now and under the claim the protocol makes now (`reviews.upholding`: same record, scope sha, shown sha, claim digest, decision digest; a non-`--again` draw and every verdict `upheld`).

the area lies in a git repository

no first measurement was found whose commit cannot be read

condition: A file of the bundle — the protocol, an area script or analysis file, or a repo helper they import — raises SourceError in `read_source`: it cannot be opened or is not UTF-8 text (code_check.py:647).

preconditions: no protocol was named on the call
alternative: bundle: the telling site (finalize.py:945) passes on `str(exc)` of any ProtocolChoiceError and does not tell apart: named protocol is a symbolic link (form), named protocol is no file, no protocol in the area, several and none named (uniqueness), the only protocol is a symbolic link (form). Classified here by the one condition whose message the cause names.
condition: No protocol is named and the area holds more than one `PROTOCOL-*.md` (`len(protocols) > 1`): a choice that needs exactly one candidate.

the covering analysis records and the protocol's records read
the carried findings form a chain

condition: A finding of a covering analysis record that carries an earlier finding (`carries`) is closed `false-positive`, and no decision review upholds it as decided now and under the claim the protocol makes now (`reviews.upholding`).

preconditions: an answering run exists
its outputs.json reads
alternative: binding: a path in the run's outputs.json (holds the reference) leads to no regular file (referred to: the kept output, also run record)
condition: An output the answering run registered in outputs.json is no file at its path now (`path_kind(path) != "file"`), raised as AuditError while the run's shown state is computed — the only AuditError this call path raises.

preconditions: a kept JSONL output holds rows of both lanes, `registered` and `null`
alternative: inner consistency, weak: two parts of one kept output are compared, but the finding is told because they are the same, not because they contradict
condition: For every item of a kept output's null lane, the pair (answer, gold) equals the registered lane's pair for that item: the test establishes that the null lane did not differ from the registered lane, a sameness inside one object that no value names.

preconditions: the report's generated blocks read (their lines are left out)
condition: A line of the report outside every generated result or discussion block states a number (`_numbers_in(line)` not empty); no source is looked up and nothing is compared — the condition fires because numbers are there.
One of the bound fields is written more than once in the protocol text (more than one field line under the same field name); the copies' values are not compared.
